existing_filter_gap.description: superband_mp_matched_no_train_leak.csv was built by keeping only rows whose mp_material_id does NOT appear in data/jepa/mp.csv.gz (exact material_id match). This misses cases where the SAME composition appears in mp.csv.gz under a DIFFERENT material_id (different polymorph/relaxation of an identical stoichiometry), which is exactly the kind of near-duplicate a JEPA encoder pretrained on that composition could exploit to trivially embed the Tc-set example it later sees, i.e. genuine leakage even though the row-level ids differ.

note_all_401_rows_leak_vs_3dsc_source: All 401 rows trivially share a composition with 3DSC_MP.csv because that is the reference table the matching script used to find MP structures for each SuperBand formula in the first place (by construction, composition_key was the join key) -- this is expected and not itself a data leak; what matters is overlap with the pretraining corpus (mp.csv.gz).
